SELECT FROM yms_appointment_rule r WHERE r.deleted = 0
AND r.rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.ruleName}, '%')
AND r.warehouse_id = #{bo.warehouseId}
AND (r.business_type = #{bo.businessType} OR r.business_type IS NULL)
AND (r.vehicle_source = #{bo.vehicleSource} OR r.vehicle_source IS NULL)
AND r.enabled = #{bo.enabled}
ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.create_time DESC

SELECT FROM yms_appointment_rule r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.enabled = 1 AND r.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND (r.business_type IS NULL OR r.business_type = #{businessType}) AND (r.vehicle_source IS NULL OR r.vehicle_source = #{vehicleSource} OR #{vehicleSource} IS NULL OR #{vehicleSource} = '') ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.create_time ASC LIMIT 1
